description: This file defines an abstract base class AbstractModel used by AWS SDK for PHP to represent API shape models, including properties for definition, shape map, and context parameters, as well as methods for array access and shape resolution.

classes.name: AbstractModel
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for AWS API shape representations, implementing ArrayAccess and providing methods for handling shape definitions and conversions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the model with a definition array and a shape map.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the shape's definition as an array.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves an element from the definition array by offset.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets an element in the definition array at the specified offset.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if an offset exists in the definition array.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes an element from the definition array at the specified offset.

methods.name: shapeAt
methods.description: Retrieves the shape at a specific key in the definition, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: shapeFor
methods.description: Creates or resolves a shape object based on the given definition.
